Move POI toward its required river within the same6mile parent hex when its placement rules require river adjacency; do not move unrelated POI merely because a river exists.
Adapt roads attached to a moved POI so that they still reach that POI.
Do not display the road inside the occupied footprint of a POI that occupies a whole hex or more.
